title: Podcast EP361: An Overview of the AI Infra Summit with Ed Nelson - Semiwiki
gist: AI Infra Summit co-founder Ed Nelson describes the event's growth from a 300-attendee semiconductor summit in 2018 to a full-stack AI infra conference with over 8,000 attendees, with keynotes including Jeff Dean, Andrew Ng, John Hennessy and Lip-Bu Tan.

insights.claim: Ed Nelson built the AI Infra Summit from a 300-attendee semiconductor summit started in 2018 into a full-stack AI infra conference attracting over 8,000 attendees.
insights.speaker: Ed Nelson
insights.so_what: Attendance growth is a proxy for the scale of AI-infrastructure investment interest.

insights.claim: Attendance at the AI Infra Summit doubled from 4,000 last year to over 8,000 this year, and sponsors increased from 150 to 250.
insights.speaker: Ed Nelson
insights.so_what: Rapid sponsor and attendee growth signals strong industry momentum in AI infra.
insights.quote: Attendance at the show has doubled from 4,000 last year to over 8,000 this year, and the number of sponsors has also increased from 150 last year to 250 this year.

insights.claim: The AI Hardware Summit and the Edge AI Summit merged last year to create the AI Infra Summit.
insights.speaker: Ed Nelson
insights.so_what: Consolidation reflects convergence of hardware and edge AI communities.

insights.claim: Unlike many events focused on the application layer, the AI Infra Summit spans the entire implementation stack and addresses the challenges of scaling and sustaining the underlying technology of AI.
insights.speaker: Ed Nelson
insights.so_what: Positioning across the full infra stack differentiates it from app-layer conferences.

insights.claim: Confirmed AI Infra Summit keynote speakers include Jeff Dean, Andrew Ng, John Hennessy and Lip-Bu Tan, at the Santa Clara Convention Center on September 15-17, 2026.
insights.speaker: Ed Nelson
insights.so_what: Marquee lineup underscores the event's stature in AI infrastructure.
